description: Only for the foam of the foams
summary:
Global wildfire records span 26 years, yet raw satellite hotspot counts cannot be compared across time: when NASA’s 375 m VIIRS instruments joined 1 km MODIS in 2012, raw detection counts jumped 2× to 5× purely from finer spatial resolution and S-NPP VIIRS ended operations in November 2026.

We built an open-science pipeline and web platform that harmonizes four NASA FIRMS sensors (MODIS Terra/Aqua, VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, and NOAA-21) onto a single continuous unit: S-NPP-VIIRS-equivalent active fire cell-days on resolution-7 H3 hexagons. Using out-of-sample monthly calibration factors fitted on 2012–2020 and validated on 2021–2025 across Río Negro (Argentina), California, and Romania, our Burning Activity Calendar reveals true 26-year×12-month seasonality, IQR anomaly scores, critical fire season windows, live NRT hotspot overlays, and NASA GIBS before/after SWIR burn-scar imagery for any user-drawn polygon.

Finally, our Tactical Containment Sandbox couples this 26-year H3 fuel-recovery history with ESA WorldCover, Copernicus terrain, and live Open-Meteo wind to benchmark human containment plans against greedy and min-cut optimizers and draft bilingual field advisories.

Link to the Github repo: https://github.com/Firefightas/fire-calendar
details:
What it does & how it works: Our platform unifies 26 years (2000–2026) of MODIS (1 km) and VIIRS (375 m S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) detections onto one scale: S-NPP-VIIRS-equivalent active fire cell-days on H3 Resolution-7 hexes (~5.16 km²). Using monthly median ratios fitted strictly on 2012–2020 and validated out-of-sample on 2021–2025, users explore 26×12 Burning Activity Calendars, ZIQRZIQR​ anomalies, critical fire windows, custom drawn-polygon queries, NASA GIBS before/after SWIR burn scars, and a Tactical Containment Sandbox simulating a Romanian firefighter's 8-step doctrine with greedy and min-cut optimizers.

Benefits & Impact: Eliminates the 2012 sensor step-change artifact (Río Negro ×5.17 → ×1.50, California ×3.13 → ×1.52, Romania ×1.90 → ×0.68) and bridges S-NPP's Nov 2, 2026 end of data via NOAA-20/21 cross-calibration. Serves civil-protection stakeholders (CONAE, CAL FIRE, IGSU/DSU Romania) with artifact-free baselines and draft advisory tooling.

Tech Stack: Python 3.11 (uv, DuckDB, pandas, h3, FastAPI), TypeScript/React 19 (Vite, Tailwind, MapLibre, deck.gl, terra-draw, Recharts, Web Workers), open NASA FIRMS/GIBS, ESA WorldCover, and Open-Meteo data on Vercel + Render (140 Python + 127 TS tests).

Creativity & Key Factors Considered: Pairs H3 cell-day harmonization directly with fuel-recovery age (years_since_last_fire) inside a 72h containment simulator; enforces strict 2012–2020 fit vs. 2021–2025 validation, industrial-flare filtering (type == 0), IQR anomalies, partial-month correction, colorblind-safe Cividis defaults, and explicit non-forecast guardrails.
